nom: goPure Tighten & Lift Neck & Chest Moisturizer Cream for Visibly Firming

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes her skin as very sensitive reports no irritation and noticeable tightening from the first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 60s, and 70s, many with sagging or crepey neck and chest skin from aging or weight loss, mostly report a firmer, smoother look after several weeks of consistent use, though a few in this group saw no change even after months.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using this for a sagging, crepey, or wrinkled neck and chest, frequently linked to weight loss or getting older, report firmer, smoother-looking skin within a few weeks to a couple of months of twice-daily use; however, several reviewers, including some who used it for two to three months or more, report no visible tightening or reduction in wrinkles at all.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the cream as strongly moisturizing, softening dry or crepey-looking skin, even among those who saw no tightening effect from it.
concerns.redness: A recurring minority of reviewers developed hives, a rash, or red, patchy, itchy skin, sometimes after using the product without issue for weeks, months, or even a year beforehand; most reviewers report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe lasting reactions requiring a dermatologist or urgent care visit, and one reports the same rash reappearing when she resumed the product after a break; others, including one with very sensitive skin, report only a brief tingling sensation or no reaction at all.
concerns.blemishes: The small number of reviewers who mention it directly say the cream did not cause breakouts or clogged pores, including when used on the chest.

aspects.libelle: Light, pleasant scent for most users
Off-putting smell develops for a few users
Jar often looks underfilled for the price
A little goes a long way, jar lasts weeks
Responsive customer service and easy refunds

extraits.texte: I don’t have sensitive skin by any means. I’ve tried many skin care products with no problem. I used the GoPure firming neck cream for a month and gradually noticed my neck was itchy. I thought it was just allergies since we had a major heat wave in my area. I continues to use it as directed. One night I noticed the irritation and skipped the cream for the night. I woke up the next morning covered in hives and rashes. This picture was when it was subsiding after showering and using a topical ointment. I stopped using this product over a week ago, and my skin is still irritated, when it’s not red, it’s patchy with dry spots.

Before and after pix tell the story. I followed instructions exactly (cleanse, serum, moisturizer, then apply the neck cream in that order) twice a day. No results. This cream is advertised everywhere and the pix on social media promise results focusing on “tech neck” and the loose skin under the chin and neck. But after 13 weeks , I did not see any improvement. The jar lasted a long time and I applied two or three fingertips amount (I didn’t skimp) and massaged it in morning and night. Besides the botanicals this contains hyaluronic acid which is supposed to hydrate skin but it doesn’t appear to actually tighten and lift. Time to look for an alternative.

It took me some time to decide to write this review, but I feel compelled to share my experience. Initially, I absolutely loved this product because I felt it was effective. I even purchased several items from the line. However, after long-term use, I began to develop a rash. After taking a break for nearly a year, I decided to give it another try. During that time, I had been using different products, but when I recently resumed using the Go Pure neck cream, I noticed the same rash reappearing on my neck. I'm not sure which ingredient in the product is causing this reaction, but now I have some remaining that I can't use due to the rash. It's frustrating because I genuinely enjoyed the product at first. I hope my experience helps someone else who might be considering this cream.

extraits.titre: First use and I’m already impressed!
extraits.texte: Ok, so I used this product once so far, pictures taken 10 min apart. There was a visible difference quickly. I planned to use a few weeks before reviewing, but had to share. I have very sensitive skin and so far no irritation. Nice smell and feels very sheer, not thick or heavy.

extraits.titre: Moisturizing but not worth the money.
extraits.texte: I have been using this product since April, 3 months now and although it feels moisturizing there has been zero improvement to my neck wrinkles. or skin texture. I wasn't expecting a miracle but some improvement would have been nice especially with the high price of the cream. I would not recommend this cream. For reference, I am in my mid 60's.

left me with deep horizontal rings on my neck that made me look way older than I am. I started applying this goPure Neck Cream twice daily, smoothing it upward toward my jawline. Within a month, those deep lines look noticeably softer and shallow. The skin on my neck feels firmer and less "slack." It is rich but doesn't cause breakouts on my chest or clog my pores. Absolute lifesaver!

This stuff works. I am 54 and over weight. I was getting really bad turkey neck with crepey skin. I still have a double chin but the skin is smooth and I can see my jaw line. I recommend giving this product a try. I paid for it and have no connection to the company. Peace ✌️ P.S. I only use a dime size at the most and it smells good.
